techStack: Framework: Express 5.2.1 — matches routes in registration order, no automatic static-before-dynamic sorting
Validation: Zod 4.4.3 via custom validate() middleware; compareQuerySchema splits comma-separated ids, enforces min 2 / max 3 array elements; productIdSchema validates a single id param
Testing: Vitest 4.1.5 + Supertest 7.2.2; tests live in src/tests/visible/*.test.ts
DB: better-sqlite3 (embedded); no migration or schema change needed for this fix
features: GET /api/products/:id — getById controller → productService.getProductById; must continue to return 200 for valid ids and 404 for unknown ids
GET /api/products/compare — compare controller → compareService.getComparison; currently unreachable because /:id is registered first
Both routes use validate() middleware; removing or replacing middleware is out of scope
No other routes in apiProductRoutes.ts besides /:id and /compare
Authenticated /products routes (productRoutes.ts) are separate and unaffected
architecture: Layer order: src/routes → src/controllers → src/services → src/db
apiProductRoutes.ts is mounted at /api/products in src/app.ts
Only apiProductRoutes.ts needs to change; controllers, services, schemas, and middleware must remain untouched
Error handling is global (errorHandler middleware in app.ts); custom errors (ValidationError, ProductNotFoundError) propagate unchanged
edgeCases: String 'compare' treated as :id — root cause of the 404 bug; eliminated by moving /compare registration above /:id
0 or 1 ids in query: compareQuerySchema rejects at middleware level → 400 (no change needed, works once route is reachable)
2–3 valid ids: compareService returns {products, count} → 200 (happy path)
Non-numeric ids: pass schema (no regex), fail service DB lookup → 400
Whitespace in ids (e.g. '1, 2'): schema trims → handled correctly
Numeric string passed to /:id that happens to be 'compare': impossible after fix since /compare matches first
